transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

I can’t shake this feeling that I’ve failed my family and that everything that’s gone wrong is my fault. My wife and my cousin actually insisted I come in to talk to someone because they've been so worried about me.
Have these feelings of guilt been present most of the day, nearly every day, and do they seem excessive or unreasonable to you?

Yes, I feel this way nearly every single day, constantly replaying missed birthdays and late nights at the office where I chose work over them. I truly believe I'm a terrible father who ruined my daughter's life, so to me, this guilt doesn't feel excessive at all. I honestly feel like I deserve every bit of it, even if others tell me otherwise.
Have you had previous episodes of low mood, guilt, and loss of interest that lasted for at least two weeks, or is this the first time you've experienced these symptoms?
No, I don't recall ever feeling this way before now. This is definitely the first time I've ever experienced these kinds of symptoms.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy, such as hobbies, work, or spending time with family?

Yes, I've completely lost interest in the things I used to love doing. I used to get so excited about closing a deal at work or grilling for the whole family on Sundays, but now I just make excuses to skip gatherings. Nothing feels enjoyable anymore, and it all just feels completely pointless.
Have you also noticed changes in your sleep or appetite, such as sleeping too much or too little, or significant weight loss or gain?

My sleep has been terrible—I lie awake staring at the ceiling for hours and then wake up at three or four in the morning with my mind racing about my daughter and work, leaving me completely worn out. As for my appetite or weight, I haven't really noticed any major changes there.
Have you had any thoughts about harming yourself or that life isn't worth living?

It's really hard to admit, but I've been thinking that it wouldn't be so bad if I just didn't wake up, and that my family might be better off without me. Sometimes when I'm driving alone on the highway, I even find myself picturing how I might do it.
